context: An app re-exports everything through reflexive per-folder barrels plus a big aggregator, and edits mostly through AI tools. The criteria check whether the answer drops the reflexive barrels for direct imports, grounds it in agent indirection, preserves a deliberate public-API barrel, and names a concrete secondary cost.

checklist.name: Drop reflexive barrels for direct imports
checklist.description: Recommends dropping the reflexive per-folder and big aggregator barrels in favour of direct path imports

checklist.name: Grounds in agent indirection
checklist.description: Grounds it in agent indirection: the barrel hides where a symbol lives, so the agent hops through re-exports or guesses the shape

checklist.name: Keeps deliberate public-API barrel
checklist.description: Keeps a deliberate barrel only at a real public-API / package boundary and does NOT say delete all barrels indiscriminately

checklist.name: Names a concrete secondary cost
checklist.description: Names at least one concrete secondary cost (circular imports, broken tree-shaking, or slow build/test startup)
